tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards: the one container. Everything a person reads sits on a card.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Insets inside a card: chips, quotes, the answer box, track beds, the side panel.

tokens.name: surface-3

tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows inside a card. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and outline-button borders, empty slot rings: 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-2`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-2`, `surface-3`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, meta, units on the same grounds as `ink`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Axis numerals and hints only; 4.5:1 on `surface` and `surface-2`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one primary action per card: a solid pill. Also the active nav item.

tokens.name: focus
